description: Create or update a provisioned Grafana alert rule on the tenant's connection: POST /api/v1/provisioning/alert-rules when no uid, else PUT /api/v1/provisioning/alert-rules/{uid}. Required: rule (the alert-rule object). Optional: uid (update an existing rule).

uid.description: UID of an existing rule to update; omit to create

name: upsert_grafana_alert_rule
